rules.title: Annual General Adjustment (AGA) cap of 5%
rules.requirement: The Annual General Adjustment by which the landlord of a fully covered unit may raise the rent each year is capped at 5%, even if the CPI-based formula in the Rent Ordinance yields a higher figure.
rules.key_value: Maximum AGA of 5% (AGA otherwise set by formula tied to the Consumer Price Index)
rules.coverage_text: Fully covered rental units: most units in multifamily properties built before 1980, single-family homes with current tenancies that began prior to 1996, single-family homes with five or more rooms rented out individually with separate leases, and fully covered government-owned or -subsidized units.
rules.exemptions: The cap does not prevent a landlord who has banked (unused) AGAs from previous years from implementing a rent increase greater than 5% to raise the rent to the rent ceiling. Partially covered units (new construction with a certificate of occupancy issued after 1980, most single-family homes, most condominiums) are not subject to rent ceilings.
rules.quoted_span: The maximum AGA is 5%. This means that, if the formula in the Rent Ordinance results in an AGA that is greater than 5%, the AGA approved by the Board for that year can be no more than 5%.

rules.title: Capital improvement rent increase petitions limited to completed improvements
rules.requirement: Landlords may petition for rent increases only for completed capital improvements and can no longer petition to have rent increases preliminarily authorized for planned capital improvements.
rules.coverage_text: Rental units with rent ceilings under the Berkeley Rent Ordinance (fully covered units).
rules.quoted_span: Landlords can only file a petition for rent increases for completed capital improvements (they can no longer petition to have rent increases preliminarily authorized for planned capital improvements).

rules.title: Minimum rental debt for nonpayment eviction
rules.requirement: A landlord may evict for nonpayment of rent only if the tenant owes rental debt equal to or greater than one month of the HUD Fair Market Rent for a unit of equivalent size in the Oakland-Fremont, CA HUD Metro FMR area for the fiscal year in which the rent is demanded.
rules.key_value: Rental debt >= one month of Fair Market Rent (Oakland-Fremont, CA HUD Metro FMR) for a unit of equivalent size
rules.coverage_text: Tenants in units fully or partially covered by the Berkeley Rent Ordinance.
rules.exemptions: Units exempt from the Rent Ordinance, including units where the tenant shares a kitchen or bath facilities with the landlord if the landlord lived in a unit on the same property at the start of the tenancy.
rules.quoted_span: For a landlord to evict a tenant for nonpayment of rent, the tenant must owe an amount of rental debt equal to or greater than one month of the Fair Market Rent (FMR) value for a unit of equivalent size in the metro area Oakland-Fremont, CA HUD Metro FMR as determined by the US Department of Housing and Urban Development for the fiscal year in which the rent is demanded.

rules.title: No eviction for failure to sign substantially similar lease
rules.requirement: A landlord cannot evict a tenant for failing to sign a substantially similar lease upon expiration of a fixed-term lease.
rules.coverage_text: Tenants in units fully or partially covered by the Berkeley Rent Ordinance.
rules.exemptions: Units exempt from the Rent Ordinance, including units where the tenant shares a kitchen or bath facilities with the landlord if the landlord lived in a unit on the same property at the start of the tenancy.
rules.quoted_span: A landlord cannot evict a tenant for failing to sign a substantially similar lease upon expiration of a fixed-term lease.

rules.title: Requirements for eviction based on breach of a material lease term
rules.requirement: To evict for a lease breach, the landlord's notice must clearly describe the alleged breach, the landlord must show the tenant's behavior was unreasonable, and the breach must cause the landlord substantial, actual damage; only mutually agreed upon lease terms count as material terms.
rules.coverage_text: Tenants in units fully or partially covered by the Berkeley Rent Ordinance.
rules.exemptions: Units exempt from the Rent Ordinance, including units where the tenant shares a kitchen or bath facilities with the landlord if the landlord lived in a unit on the same property at the start of the tenancy.
rules.quoted_span: In any notice terminating a tenancy for a lease breach, the landlord must clearly describe the alleged breach. The landlord must demonstrate that the tenant’s behavior was unreasonable, and may not evict tenants for lease breaches that do not cause the landlord any actual harm.

rules.title: Eviction notice content and Rent Board filing requirement
rules.requirement: Any notice terminating a tenancy must state that advice is available from the Rent Board and give its housing counseling phone number and website address, and the landlord must file copies of termination notices, notices to quit, and summons and complaints with the Rent Board no later than three business days after service on the tenant.
rules.key_value: File with Rent Board within three business days of service
rules.coverage_text: Tenants in units fully or partially covered by the Berkeley Rent Ordinance.
rules.exemptions: Units exempt from the Rent Ordinance, including units where the tenant shares a kitchen or bath facilities with the landlord if the landlord lived in a unit on the same property at the start of the tenancy.
rules.quoted_span: Eviction notices must contain certain information directing tenants to the Rent Board, and copies of eviction notices and eviction lawsuits must be filed with the Rent Board within three business days of serving the tenant.

rules.title: Mandatory annual adjustment of owner move-in relocation assistance
rules.requirement: The Rent Board must make inflationary adjustments to owner move-in eviction relocation assistance amounts each year.
rules.coverage_text: Owner move-in evictions of tenants in units covered by the Berkeley Rent Ordinance.
rules.quoted_span: The Rent Board must make inflationary adjustments to owner move-in eviction relocation assistance amounts each year.
